name: word-roller-3d-carousel
title: Word Roller 3D Carousel
description: Words stand around a cylinder that spins in perspective: it starts slowly, spins fast, slows, and stops on the last word, which turns to the accent colour and grows while the others stay dim.
useWhen: A ring of words (innovation, creation, evolution…) that should spin and land on one big word.
A reveal with depth, where the words that go past stay visible in perspective.
avoidWhen: Words that must be read individually while rolling.
Long words: the ring gets wide and the cylinder shrinks the text.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words around the cylinder, separated by commas. The last one is where it stops.
variables.default: Innovation, Creation, Evolution, Revolution, Transformation, INSPIRATION

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the words in pixels. The cylinder shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Active color
variables.description: Color of the word facing the viewer.

variables.label: Final color
variables.description: Color of the last word once it has stopped.

variables.label: Spin length
variables.description: Frames the cylinder takes to reach the last word (30 fps).

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
